answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each enrolled agent key to remote attestation of an approved MRENCLAVE and a hardware-rooted TEE credential. Because a VM clone cannot forge that credential, duplicating an identity requires access to genuine attestation-capable silicon, not copying virtual machines; enrollment policy must also limit identities per device. MRENCLAVE identifies code, not a unique chip, so it is not alone a harbor against Sybils or a hollow guarantee. Hardware-backed checks are the nectar that strengthens the defense.
